user.title: Honeywell Home (EMEA) account
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use in the Honeywell Home app. Only a refresh token is stored, not the password.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored session for {email} expired. Enter the Honeywell Home password again.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in rejected. Check the email and password (accounts with extra sign-in steps such as MFA are not supported).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Honeywell Home service.
error.no_thermostats: No thermostats found on this account.

set_hold.name: Set hold
set_hold.description: Hold a setpoint permanently, or until a time of day.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Setpoint to hold. Defaults to the current setpoint.

until.name: Until
until.description: Hold until this time of day (rounded to 10 minutes; needs the schedule running). Leave empty for a permanent hold.

set_holiday.name: Set holiday
set_holiday.description: Book holiday/away mode on the thermostat.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the holiday starts. Defaults to now.

cancel_holiday.name: Cancel holiday
cancel_holiday.description: Cancel a booked or running holiday.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the weekly schedule: per day a list of periods with start time and temperature.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the periods of the given days (same format as Get schedule returns). Days left out stay unchanged; an empty list clears a day.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Days (monday..sunday) mapped to lists of {start: "HH:MM", temperature}.
